business_problem: ATAL Engineering Group needed a better way to support building energy analytics and optimization for large commercial properties because an on-premises analytics stack could not process historical building data fast enough or cheaply enough to support sustainable building operations at scale.
solution_summary: ATAL Engineering Group uses Delta Lake and Amazon Bedrock to support building energy analytics and optimization for large commercial properties. The implementation replaced a legacy state where an on-premises analytics stack could not process historical building data fast enough or cheaply enough to support sustainable building operations at scale. Building sensor and operations data and historical energy consumption move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake and Amazon S3, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Central governance keeps access, lineage, and compliance consistent across downstream teams. Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, and Amazon EMR operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver optimization recommendations and energy analytics dashboards.
business_outcome: ATAL Engineering Group improved building energy analytics and optimization for large commercial properties with measurable results including 200% increase in analytics performance, 50% reduction in platform management time, and 80% decrease in downtime, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
